svg.title: Reading the NaOH enthalpy–concentration chart (MSH Fig. 16.6)
svg.text: Reading the NaOH enthalpy–concentration chart (MSH Fig. 16.6)
NaOH–water H–x chart (after McCabe), redrawn; isotherms every 10 °F, dashed = extrapolated; right: zooms
Feed x = 0.20 at 100 °F: go up from 0.20 to the 100 °F isotherm.
Go across to the enthalpy axis. 3 → 4 H_F = 55 Btu/lb.
Thick liquor x = 0.50 at its boiling point 197 °F: go up to the 197 °F isotherm (between 190 and 200 °F, dashed).
Go across to the enthalpy axis. 7 → 8 H_L = 221 Btu/lb.
Redrawn from the printed chart (digitized); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
